title: PendingReview
description: The user's pending review on GitHub, merged over every pending review of the user.

commenting_available.description: False when the GitHub App is not installed on the repository.

comments.description: Pending comments; the count is their number.

incomplete.description: The server stopped reading at its cap (more pending comments or reviews exist on GitHub than listed).

PendingComment.description: A comment in the pending review.

side.description: Diff side of a line comment (GitHub LEFT = base, RIGHT = head).

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line comment; for a file-level comment, of the linked range.

line.description: Last line; for a file-level comment, of the linked range.

CommentKind.description: Where a pending comment sits on GitHub.

oneOf.description: A line thread inside the diff.
A file-level thread of a file in the PR diff whose body links to lines outside the diff hunks.

LineSide.description:
Commit a line number refers to. Head is the common case (final code); base only for code that no longer
exists at the head commit (a deleted file, an emptied file, removed lines without a head line to anchor to).

oneOf.description: Lines of the base commit (removed code).
